text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'infer-prod-eu' queue > 85% for 6m, autoscaler attempted scale but hit max_capacity=24. Throttles observed. Alert severity: P1.

alice (oncall): ack. I'm looking. any initial customer impact reports?

eve (support): seeing many timeouts to the /v1/generate endpoint since ~2899989900. Slack thread with affected customers: CUST-1242, CUST-3387. They're seeing 503s and long tail latency.

bob (sre): grabbing autoscaler logs now. quick snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T07:20:30Z autoscaler: scale_attempt -> desired=28, max=24, result=cap_hit
2026-03-15T07:21:10Z pool-manager: lock_acquired=kv-shard-rebalance, scale_blocked=true
2026-03-15T07:22:05Z serving-runtime: prefix-cache misses spiked 10x
```
looks like a rebalance held pool lock while a config change coincided.

carol (eng-ml infra): we rolled continuous-batching v2 -> v3 at 2899989600. v3 changed batch_window_ms from 20 -> 5 and kv_prefix_ttl from 30s -> 0s (intentionally aggressive). That reduced prefix cache effectiveness; combined with kv-shard-rebalance it amplified misses.

david (eng-runtime): fewer batches means less amortized kernel utilization -> lower throughput per-GPU. With prefix cache misses we regenerate KV cache frequently, hitting memory and I/O. Two factors combined: lower batching + cache miss storm -> queue growth.

alice (oncall): ok mitigation plan? We need immediate customer relief. Options: roll back batching config, bump pool capacity, abort rebalance, enable fallback model. Which is fastest?

frank (platform): aborting rebalance requires manual lock release from the controller. I can do that now but it might cause some shard duplication if mid-move. Safer: roll back batching config to v2 (fast config push) + temporarily increase max_capacity to 36 for 10m.

bob (sre): agree. Rollback batching config first (no infra restart), then scale cap while we drain queue. I'll prepare commands.

carol (eng-ml infra): patch ready. rollback payload: 
```
PATCH /config/continuous-batching
{ "version": "v2", "batch_window_ms": 20, "kv_prefix_ttl": 30 }
```
I can deploy in ~30s.

alice (oncall): do it and post the operation id. I'll notify customers about mitigation in progress. @eve can you post an interim status?

eve (support): posting now to CUST-1242 and CUST-3387: "We are aware of increased latency and 503s; mitigation in progress (rolling back a recent batching config and temporarily adding capacity). ETA ~10-15m." :thumbsup:

frank (platform): scaling max_capacity to 36 now. command: 
```
platformctl pools set-capacity infer-prod-eu --max 36 --duration 10m
```
applied: op_id=op-20260315-01

incident-bot: action logged: rollback_request_id=cfg-rollback-2899990001, scale_op=op-20260315-01.

carol (eng-ml infra): deploying rollback... done. cfg-rollback-2899990001 applied to 100% of serving nodes.

bob (sre): seeing prefix-cache miss rate drop immediately in metrics (down from 92% miss -> 18% miss). queue length trending down. autoscaler no longer blocked by pool lock (rebalance aborted by platform).

david (eng-runtime): throughput per GPU back to baseline after ~60s. observed worker hot-loop caused some OOMs earlier; I've cycled two pods (graceful): 
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-worker -n infer-prod
```
pods restarted successfully.

alice (oncall): customers updated? eve?

eve (support): CUST-1242 updated: "Mitigation in place, latency improving. We'll monitor and follow up." CUST-3387 same. Opening incident postmortem ticket for both.

bob (sre): raw numbers: peak queue 11k requests, ~24% request failures at peak, mean latency from 120ms -> 2.1s during peak tail. After rollback+scale, failures down to 2%, p95 ~220ms.

frank (platform): reverted rebalance and unlocked pool. We need a safer rebalance strategy (staggered, respect traffic windows). I'll add to follow-up actions.

carol (eng-ml infra): root cause summary to add to postmortem: aggressive continuous-batching v3 reduced batching aggregation; kv_prefix_ttl=0 caused near-zero prefix cache reuse; combined with an in-flight kv-shard-rebalance that held pool locks -> cache miss storm and autoscaler cap hit.

alice (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @bob you'll lead follow-ups. Please verify no regressions in canary and schedule a safer rollout (staged traffic + synthetic traffic warmup). Owners: bob (sre) postmortem, carol (ml infra) batching config guardrails, frank (platform) rebalance safety.

bob (sre): ack. I'll collect logs, timeline, and start postmortem doc. Estimated RCA draft in 24h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated - queue decreasing, autoscaler unblocked, configs rolled back, capacity increased temporarily. Status: monitoring.

alice (oncall): closing P1 to P2 once stable for 30m. Leaving notes in incident board. Good work team.

frank (platform): follow-ups: add automatic guardrail to prevent kv_prefix_ttl <=5s on high-qps services, add preflight check that prevents rebalance during high queue or active rollout.

carol (eng-ml infra): will add canary traffic warmup script + automated warm cache step before kv_prefix_ttl changes.

bob (sre): linking logs and graphs: https://grafana.redwood/infer-prod/2899990001 (will attach to postmortem).

alice (oncall): handing off to morning shift: details in the postmortem draft. If anything spikes, re-alert. Good job. :white_check_mark:
